name: Twenty
tagline: An open-source CRM with a React frontend, NestJS backend, and application SDK.
hook: Explains how branch-local build output and Nx caching can produce misleading failures or stale passes.
summary: Twenty's AGENTS.md resolves to CLAUDE.md, a compact guide to a multi-package CRM. It prioritizes neighboring code, identifies recurring agent mistakes, and records verification and migration pitfalls that are not apparent from the commands alone.

techniques.title: Give surrounding code precedence over written defaults
techniques.body: The opening instruction makes adjacent files the authority when local conventions differ. It explicitly includes file naming, which varies across this monorepo.
techniques.quote: Match the surrounding code — the adjacent files in the directory you are editing beat any written rule, including for file naming, which varies by area.

techniques.title: Identify stale artifacts before diagnosing failures
techniques.body: The guide treats the shared package output as branch-specific state. It requires rebuilding without Nx cache after branch switches or shared-package edits before trusting dependent test results.
techniques.quote: - **`twenty-shared/dist` is per-branch state nothing tracks.** After switching branches or editing `twenty-shared`, run `npx nx build twenty-shared --skip-nx-cache` before trusting any typecheck or test failure in a dependent package.

techniques.title: Bypass cached success when verifying a fix
techniques.body: A separate gotcha warns that the task runner can return an old passing result. It names a direct compiler invocation for checking whether a change actually fixes the problem.
techniques.quote: - **Nx caching can serve a stale pass.** To verify a fix, run `npx tsgo -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` in the package directly rather than `nx typecheck`.

techniques.title: Keep incidental generated changes out of a patch
techniques.body: Translation extraction can rewrite large catalogs as a side effect of editing a message. The guide reserves those files for translation work and leaves their routine maintenance to the translation pipeline.
techniques.quote: **Do not commit translation catalogs unless translations are the task.**

techniques.title: Name an observed agent failure
techniques.body: The house rules point to existing guard packages before allowing new helpers. They identify redundant utilities as a recurring agent-authored defect, giving the lookup step a concrete reason.
techniques.quote: Reimplementing an existing util is the most common AI-authored defect here.

steal: State when local examples override repository-wide defaults.
Document build artifacts that survive branch switches.
Name a verification command that bypasses task caches.
Exclude incidental generated files from unrelated patches.
